expected_root_cause: The HorizontalPodAutoscaler sample-app-hpa cannot compute CPU utilization because the target Deployment's container has no CPU resource request set. HPA requires a CPU request on the target to calculate a utilization percentage, so its current metric value is unknown/missing and it cannot scale, even though the cluster's metrics pipeline itself is otherwise healthy.
key_evidence: get_resource(kind=HORIZONTALPODAUTOSCALER) shows an unknown or missing current CPU metric, or a condition indicating it could not compute the resource metric (e.g. missing request for cpu)
get_resource(kind=DEPLOYMENT) shows the container has no resources.requests.cpu set
should_not_conclude: The Deployment is unhealthy or crashlooping
The cluster's metrics-server is down or uninstalled
